name: Iron Constitution
flavourText: Years of punishment have conditioned the body to endure blows that would stop another sorcerer.
mechanicText: Gain 15 DURABILITY.

name: Miracle Reservoir
flavourText: The technique quietly removes the tiny coincidences that once made life feel impossible, keeping them beyond memory until they are needed.
mechanicText: Store 5 MIRACLES, increasing to 6 at CTM 15, 7 at CTM 120, and 8 at CTM 225. At BATTLE START, gain up to 6 MIRACLES, limited by capacity.

name: Fateful Reprieve
flavourText: At the instant fate closes in, a forgotten coincidence returns and turns an ending aside.
mechanicText: Automatically spend 1 MIRACLE to negate damage or an effect that would reduce you to 0 HP.

name: Fortune Reclaimed
flavourText: A near miss or a perfectly timed strike leaves another small impossibility behind to be collected.
mechanicText: Gain 1 MIRACLE when an enemy ATTACK misses you, or when you land a BLACK FLASH, up to your MIRACLE capacity.

name: Ratio Reinforcement
flavourText: Even ordinary cursed-energy reinforcement can briefly reveal the seven-to-three weak point.
mechanicText: RATIO STACK capacity increases from 2 to 5 with CTM. Connected REINFORCEMENT ATTACKS have a CTM-scaled 3%-15% chance to apply RATIO, bypassing BLOCK and reducing DEFENSE to 30% for that hit.

name: New Shadow Style
flavourText: A learned school of swordsmanship and barrier techniques developed so sorcerers without inherited techniques can defend themselves against superior jujutsu.
mechanicText: Make BATTO SWORD DRAWING and SIMPLE DOMAIN AVAILABLE to learn.

name: Simple Domain Binding Vow
flavourText: Miwa anchors both feet to the point where her stance began, sacrificing all movement to maintain the boundary.
mechanicText: Using another move while SIMPLE DOMAIN is active dispels SIMPLE DOMAIN.

name: Earnest Swordswoman
flavourText: Miwa's diligent practice gives every measured draw more force than her unassuming presence suggests.
mechanicText: Increase BASE POWER of SWORD moves by 10%.

name: Vessel of Sukuna
flavourText: A body capable of containing the King of Curses bears qualities beyond those of an ordinary vessel.
mechanicText: Grant access to FREAK OF NATURE, IMMUNE TO POISONS, and VESSEL.

name: Freak of Nature
flavourText: An extraordinary body possesses physical ability far beyond normal human limits.
mechanicText: Set the minimum allocation of VITALITY, STRENGTH, DURABILITY, and SPEED to 60.

name: Immune to Poisons
flavourText: Toxins are neutralised before they can corrupt the body.
mechanicText: Become immune to POISON.

name: Vessel
flavourText: Two souls inhabit one body while preserving the boundary between them.
mechanicText: Grant access to VISUALISE THE SOUL.

name: Visualise the Soul
flavourText: Awareness of the soul's shape allows a blow or healing energy to reach it directly.
mechanicText: PHYSICAL MELEE attacks can strike the SOUL. RCT can heal the user's SOUL.

name: Ten Shadows Technique
flavourText: The user shapes their shadow into an intermediary for ten distinct shikigami, calling them forth through hand signs.
mechanicText: Unlock the TEN SHADOWS technique tree and its SHIKIGAMI summons.

name: Parallel Manifestation
flavourText: With greater command of the shadows, the user sustains several manifested shikigami at once.
mechanicText: Set MAX ACTIVE SUMMONS to 1, increasing to 2 at CTM 30 and 3 at CTM 60.

name: Partially Realised Heavenly Restriction
flavourText: A binding placed upon Maki at birth suppresses her jujutsu potential in exchange for a body that has only begun to realise its inhuman potential.
mechanicText: Grant access to FREAK OF NATURE, JUJUTSU INAPTITUDE, HEAVENLY BODY, and PARTIAL RESISTANCE TO CURSES.

name: Jujutsu Inaptitude
flavourText: Maki possesses barely enough cursed energy to distinguish her from an ordinary human and cannot shape it into jujutsu of her own.
mechanicText: Cap CURSED ENERGY RESERVES, CURSED ENERGY EFFICIENCY, CURSED ENERGY OUTPUT, and JUJUTSU SKILL at 10. Set JUJUTSU ART slots to 0.

name: Heavenly Body
flavourText: Without cursed-energy reinforcement, Maki withstands punishment through the exceptional resilience of her own flesh and bone.
mechanicText: Calculate DEFENSE as round(SCALED DURABILITY x 8 / 6), ignoring cursed-energy reinforcement.

name: Partial Resistance to Curses
flavourText: A Heavenly Restriction leaves only the faintest trace of cursed energy within Maki, blunting the curses that would prey on it.
mechanicText: Reduce all CURSED ENERGY damage taken by 5%.

name: Cursed Tool Access
flavourText: Granted access to a variety of Cursed Tools, they do not need to reinforce weapons with their own Cursed Energy
mechanicText: Allows the user to use CURSED TOOL moves without their requirements.

name: Totality
flavourText: When a shikigami falls in battle, its essence is not lost — the survivor permanently inherits that power, forging a stronger and lasting fusion that cannot be undone.
mechanicText: Unlock TOTALITY shikigami: permanent fusions born from a destroyed shikigami's inherited essence. Stronger than any living fusion.

name: Shadows Unravel
flavourText: When the last of the user's cursed energy fades, every maintained shadow loses its form and returns to darkness.
mechanicText: At 0 CE, DESUMMON every owned SHIKIGAMI.

name: Ten Shadows Shikigami
flavourText: This familiar is sustained through its summoner's shadow and may withdraw into it at will.
mechanicText: Unlock DESUMMON.

name: White Dog
flavourText: The white Divine Dog pursues cursed traces with exceptional speed and precision.
mechanicText: Unlock DIVINE DOG BITE and TRACKING POUNCE

name: Black Dog
flavourText: The black Divine Dog brings greater force to the hunt, ripping apart anything it corners.
mechanicText: Unlock DIVINE DOG BITE and RENDING POUNCE

name: Nue
flavourText: Nue dominates the air and channels cursed lightning through its wings and talons.
mechanicText: Unlock ELECTRIFIED TALONS and LIGHTNING DISCHARGE. Drain 0.35 CE from the summoner each active tick.

name: Toad
flavourText: Toad controls space with a long, powerful tongue suited to striking and binding prey.
mechanicText: Unlock TONGUE LASH and BINDING TONGUE

name: Great Serpent
flavourText: Great Serpent overwhelms prey with its immense coils before swallowing the opening whole.
mechanicText: Unlock SERPENT CONSTRICT and DEVOURING LUNGE

name: Divine Dog Totality
flavourText: Totality concentrates the Divine Dogs' inherited power into a predator of extraordinary speed and force.
mechanicText: Unlock TOTALITY CLAW and PREDATOR RUSH

name: Max Elephant
flavourText: Max Elephant manifests overwhelming mass and a vast volume of water through the user's shadow.
mechanicText: Unlock CRUSHING STOMP and WATER DELUGE

name: Toad/Nue Fusion
flavourText: Through Well's Unknown Abyss, Toad and Nue merge into a winged swarm that binds enemies from above while striking with coordinated tongues and talons.
mechanicText: Unlock WINGED TONGUE SNARE and AERIAL SWARM. Drain 0.45 CE from the summoner each active tick.

name: Cursed Speech
flavourText: The snake-and-fangs seal turns spoken commands into compulsory cursed energy, forcing listeners to obey at a cost to the user's throat.
mechanicText: Enable CURSED SPEECH commands. Each selected target independently resists using current CE; every attempt inflicts target-CE-scaled RECOIL even when resisted.

name: Refined Commands
flavourText: Careful diction and disciplined cursed-energy control make each command harder to resist without increasing its strain.
mechanicText: At CTM 60, add min(20, CTM / 12) percentage points to CURSED SPEECH command success chance.

name: Cursed Tool Reinforcement
flavourText: A cursed tool bears the burden of reinforcement itself, letting its wielder strike with cursed energy that is not their own.
mechanicText: When using a weapon-required move with exactly PHYSICAL and CURSED ENERGY damage tags, set its CE cost to 0.

name: Well's Unknown Abyss
flavourText: Two living shikigami are drawn together into a single composite shadow — a temporary union weaker than any Totality, but one that may be broken apart and reformed freely, for its components never truly die.
mechanicText: Unlock WELLS UNKNOWN ABYSS shikigami: temporary fusions of two living shikigami. Weaker than Totality, but destroyed at no lasting cost.
